title: Abandon Task Branch response
description: The reply of fleetd, from the requests row of the request_id: state applied with its result, or refused with its reason (A24). The result names the rescue ref of the branch. A retry with the same request_id returns this reply again.

state.description: Closed list from requests.state without pending: applied or refused (A24).

rescue_ref.description: The verified rescue ref, e.g. refs/horch/rescue/T-0007-03/1.

result.description: The stored result, requests.result_json. Present only when state is applied.

reason.description: Why fleetd refused the request, requests.reason: e.g. no valid operator token, a caller inside a live attempt, a known request_id with another payload hash, a wrong state. Present only when state is refused.
